name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(door_open, key_lost) forbids dropping the key while the door is closed before it has been opened once, and Existence(at_goal) requires reaching the goal.
